episode.title: Episode 12: twenty years after the Moon
episode.guest_release_note: EXAMPLE ONLY: invented. The footage is NASA's public-domain archive video

clips.why: Earth small and fragile, the Moon not a place but a direction: two surprising lines from someone who went, in under half a minute. Stands alone and ends on the line people quote.
clips.hook: The Moon isn't a place. It's a direction
clips.title: An Apollo 11 astronaut: the Moon is a direction, not a place (1989)

clips.why: A bold proposal said plainly: a long-range goal for Mars with no timetable, and why it would unite everyone. Opens on the speaker, and the year in the hook keeps it true today.
